title: DeepMind's AlphaGenome 2 predicts variants cell by cell
summary: Google DeepMind released AlphaGenome 2, a DNA model that predicts how variants affect one cell type at a time instead of averaging across tissues. Trained on more than 107 million cell profiles from 68 tissues, it identified nearly twice as many causal variants (30% versus 16%) and directional gene effects (43% versus 23%) on the TenK10K immune-cell benchmark. It is free for non-commercial research and in private preview for commercial use.
